action.action-desc: Ms. Garcia of Texas (for herself, Mr. García of Illinois, Ms. Ocasio-Cortez, Ms. Escobar, and Mr. Correa) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Financial Services

form.official-title: To prohibit the Secretary of Housing and Urban Development from implementing certain rules.

section.text: The Secretary of Housing and Urban Development may not implement, administer, enforce, or in any manner make effective the proposed rule entitled Housing and Community Development Act of 1980: Verification of Eligible Status, issued by the Department of Housing and Urban Development on May 10, 2019 (Docket No. FR–6124–P–01), or any final rule based substantially on such proposed rule.
